ownership.quote: Chronicle Labs is a staging environment for enterprise AI agents: we capture every event the agent sees in production and backtest it, so customers can safely test new behaviors without breaking anything.

stage.note: Confirmed YC-backed (Spring 2026 batch, same domain chronicle-labs.com verified on the YC company page), founded 2026, team of 2. No priced round (amount, investors, or stage) was found in any press, blog, or aggregator; company almost certainly holds at least a YC pre-seed SAFE, but no dollar figure or explicit 'pre-seed'/'seed' label is publicly confirmed as of the check date.
